description: This file provides utility functions related to prompt handling in a React/TypeScript project. It includes methods for extracting variables from prompt content, handling prompt IDs and versions, extracting models from prompt data, and retrieving providers from model data. The functions support prompt management and data extraction within a UI component for a machine learning or LLM application.

methods.name: extractTemplateVariables
methods.description: Extracts template variables enclosed in {{ }} from a prompt content string, returning a record of variable names mapped to example values.

methods.name: getBasePromptId
methods.description: Retrieves the base prompt ID from a PromptSpec object, stripping version information.

methods.name: getVersionedPromptId
methods.description: Generates a versioned prompt ID based on PromptSpec, preserving version information from litellm_params.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of a prompt, either from the prompt data itself or by extracting it from the ID.

methods.name: extractModel
methods.description: Attempts to extract the model name from various fields within a PromptSpec object, including dotprompt_content, prompt_data, and litellm_params.

methods.name: getProviderFromModelHub
methods.description: Retrieves the provider name associated with a model from model hub data, returning the first provider listed.
